items.name: Welcome
items.body: Hi {parent}, thanks for your interest in Learnibility for {student}. I am {rep}, your counsellor. When is a good time for a 10-minute call?

items.name: No-reply nudge
items.body: Hi {parent}, just checking in. Would you like a free diagnostic for {student} this week? Reply YES and I will set it up.

items.name: Demo confirmation
items.body: Your Learnibility demo for {student} is confirmed for {demo}. You will get the joining link an hour before.

items.name: Demo reminder
items.body: Reminder: {student}’s Learnibility demo is at {demo}. Join here: learnibility.demo/meet/{lead}

items.name: Missed demo, reschedule
items.body: We missed you today, {parent}. Pick a new slot for {student}’s demo: learnibility.demo/book/{lead}

items.name: Proposal
items.body: Dear {parent}, as discussed, here is the plan for {student}: {package} at {price} plus GST. The proposal is valid for 7 days.

items.name: Payment link
items.body: Here is the secure payment link for {package} ({total} incl. GST): {link}

items.name: Payment received
items.body: Payment of {total} received, thank you! Invoice {invoice} is on its way. {student}’s Learnibility account is being set up.

items.name: Monthly nurture
items.body: Hi {parent}, this month at Learnibility: free board-exam strategy webinar on Saturday. Want a seat for {student}?

items.name: Welcome to the platform
items.body: Welcome aboard! {student} can sign in at learnibility.demo with this mobile number. First step: the 30-minute starting test.
